claude_code.verification_method: changelog + live-CLI method (automated nightly review). This entry had drifted: master's own copy stayed pinned at 2.1.263 (verified 2026-09-06/07) while the review work for 2.1.267 through 2.1.272 accumulated on this repo's long-open rolling `claude-code-update` PR without ever landing. The 2.1.263→2.1.273 reconciliation cycle (2026-09-16) merged that PR against current master and extended coverage to 2.1.273 on changelog evidence only, no live CLI being available then. Tonight's cycle (2026-09-17) had a live `claude` CLI in the automation environment, reporting exactly `2.1.274` — the current release — so `validated_against` advances all the way to it on real evidence, and `claude plugin validate .` was re-run for real and passed (marketplace manifest valid). 2.1.259–2.1.263 review (2026-09-06/07): `/skill-doctor`, `bashOutputMaxChars`/`taskOutputMaxChars`, a worktree-isolation permission fix, `/reload-plugins` for headless sessions — see CLAUDE.md's Subagents/Hooks bullets for the full per-item narrative. 2.1.267: the `effort:` frontmatter fix (directly relevant — 27 SKILL.md files here set `effort:`), `maxEffortLevel`, and a marketplace entry-path containment hardening protective of this plugin's `tamirs-marketplace` distribution. 2.1.268: `claude plugin install/uninstall/update/enable/disable --json` — adopted in `scripts/update.sh`/`scripts/uninstall.sh` (see `features_adopted`); `PermissionRequest` hooks firing in `--print` mode; `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` fix; MCP `${VAR}`-placeholder secret-leak fix; agent-team untrusted-file isolation fix. 2.1.269 (largest delta in the range): a `PreToolUse` deny rule and the `Edit()` write-path check now also apply to a Bash `tee` write, and a `Bash(tee:*)` allow rule is correctly scoped — closes, host-side, exactly the gap `hooks/guard-sensitive-files.sh`'s header comment names and already covers independently via `hooks/lib/write-targets.py`'s own `tee` parsing (neither bug was ever exposed here, since `platforms/claude/settings.d/permissions-allow.json`/`permissions-ask.json` declare no `Bash(tee:*)` rule of either kind); a bare-`!` deny/ask rule leak is fixed (no rule here starts with `!`); the attribution-reminder-overriding-CLAUDE.md bug is fixed (this repo's CLAUDE.md asks *for* the trailer, so never conflicted); plugin-archive extraction hardening (host-side, no manifest change); `claude plugin eval` is genuinely relevant to this toolkit's 27 skills but its `case.yaml`/`prompt.md`+`graders` shape does not match this repo's existing per-skill `evals/evals.json`/`trigger-evals.json` trigger-accuracy harness, so it is tracked as a Future opportunity rather than adopted blind this cycle. 2.1.270: bug-fix-only (a same-week regression in 2.1.269) — read-only git commands in Bash no longer unexpectedly ask for permission after a long-running session; relevant since `permissions-allow.json` pre-allows several git commands specifically to avoid this class of friction. 2.1.271: a stale `.git/config.lock` after a sandboxed command failure no longer breaks `git checkout -b`/`git push -u`/`git config` for the rest of the session (Linux) — relevant since `permissions-allow.json` pre-allows `git push *`/`git remote add *`/`git init` for the same reason, and `hooks/worktree-create.sh` runs through the same sandboxed Bash surface; the Monitor watch deadline change (always at most 30 minutes, 10 in `-p` runs) — `skills/dev-workflow/pr-dev/references/ci-monitor-loop.md`'s one Monitor wrapper already sets `timeout_ms: 1800000` and never set `persistent`, so it was already inside the new ceiling; a background command no longer starting a second copy of itself after compaction, relevant to a long `orchestrate-dev`/`worker-dev` fan-out; cross-session `SendMessage` delivery now gives the headless sender a delivery notice instead of holding the message silently — documented in `docs/user/cross-platform-workflow.md`. `omitClaudeMd` (new agent frontmatter) and per-command `allowed_domains` for auto-mode sandboxing were reviewed and deliberately not adopted: no `agents/*.md` here should skip the target project's own CLAUDE.md, and no shipped rule runs Bash under auto mode with sandboxing. 2.1.272: bug-fixes-and-reliability-improvements only, per the official changelog; no adoptable item. 2.1.273: a 2.1.268 change that checked `Read`/`Edit` deny rules on Bash lines the permission checker cannot fully analyze (`eval`, `env -C`) is reverted — this repo declares no such rule pattern, so the revert changes generic host behavior but nothing this repo declares; `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` now also tags cost/token metrics with real agent/skill/plugin/MCP-server names — not wired here, this repo ships no OpenTelemetry config of its own; the `New Features` section of the 2.1.273 changelog entry repeats 2.1.271's items verbatim (fast mode in Remote sessions, `/config` mouse support, `--drain-marker-file`, per-command `allowed_domains`, `omitClaudeMd`, `--accept-command <sha256>`, `modelPricing` multiplier) — already reviewed in the 2.1.271 pass above, no new review needed. 2.1.274 (this cycle's new coverage): a sub-agent's progress summary is no longer replaced by a runaway multi-paragraph reply — directly relevant to `worker-dev`'s `completed`/`partial`/`failed`/`blocked` handoff vocabulary and any `orchestrate-dev` fan-out reading a worker's summary back; `claude agents` no longer loses `--model`/`--effort`/`--permission-mode`/`--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`/`--agent` after an auto-update — no script here shells out to `claude agents` directly, so not exercised, but relevant to a contributor invoking one of the ten `agents/*.md` from that CLI subcommand by hand; a visible low-memory warning is added (host UI, nothing to adopt); `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` is added — reviewed against this plugin's one MCP server (`github`, whose Docker fallback path can be slow to start on a cold pull) and documented as an available knob in CLAUDE.md's MCP bullet rather than set as a repo default, since the right value is workstation-dependent. Reviewed and found not applicable: an `effort` attribute on the OTel span (no OpenTelemetry config shipped here); Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/telemetry-disabled sessions defaulting to MCP client v2 (this repo targets direct Claude Code/Desktop sessions, not a Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry gateway); a sub-agent `model: "opus"` leaving the wrong session model on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry (all ten `agents/*.md` pin `model: sonnet`, and again no Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry usage); `/code-review` moving to leaner inline prompts (this repo references the official `code-review@claude-plugins-official` marketplace plugin in `platforms/claude/settings.d/plugins.json`, but has it deliberately disabled, so nothing here changes either way). No breaking changes or deprecations anywhere in the 2.1.263→2.1.274 range. Also reviewed for PR #154/#155/#156/#157 (2026-09-16, merged to master ahead of the prior reconciliation): SessionEnd-hook-budget fix, `handoff-reminder.sh` SessionEnd-schema fix, the 27-skill stale `model: claude-sonnet-4-6` pin fix, and the 3.6.3 release cut — all internal repo fixes with no platform-target, capability, or Claude-Code-host-version impact, so no co-change to the claims above was needed. See `CLAUDE.md`'s Subagents, Hooks, MCP, Marketplace cache, and Remote and headless Claude sessions sections for the per-release narrative in prose form.

A narrow opt-in exception is skills/toolkit/usage-capture/opencode-plugin.mjs (zero npm imports, observe-only, not listed in this repo's opencode.json) for local usage JSONL.
